zones.label: Goal and Baseline
zones.summary: Choose a meaningful goal and notice the current starting point.
facts: Goals can focus on skill, energy, consistency, function, or enjoyment.
Avoid comparing bodies or starting points.

zones.label: Endurance
zones.summary: Endurance activities challenge the heart, lungs, and sustained movement.
facts: Walking, wheeling, dancing, cycling, swimming, and games can count.

zones.label: Strength
zones.summary: Strength work helps muscles, bones, movement, and daily function.
facts: Technique, supervision, and appropriate resistance matter.
Extreme loads are not needed for progress.

zones.label: Mobility
zones.summary: Mobility combines usable range of motion, control, and comfort.
facts: Warm up with movement that fits the activity.
Stretching should not be forced through pain.

zones.label: Recovery and Revision
zones.summary: Rest, sleep, nutrition, hydration, and easier days support adaptation.
facts: Pain, illness, fatigue, or schedule changes may require revision.
